Class CardTopRowControllerVisitor

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.gc06.mesos.model.cards.CardVisitor
it.polimi.gc06.mesos.controller.CardTopRowControllerVisitor
public class CardTopRowControllerVisitor extends CardVisitor
A visitor that handles the logic for picking a card from the top row. It safely routes character cards to the turn manager while rejecting event cards, which cannot be manually picked by players.
